extracted.intended_audience: general readers of 19th-century sentimental/romance fiction (Victorian-era novel readers)
extracted.subtask_description: A chapter excerpt from a mid-19th-century sentimental/romance novel (serialized-style prose) recounting scenes, character emotions, and melodramatic events such as shipwreck, family reunions, and death. The text is narrative fiction aimed at evoking pathos and moral reflection.
